notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where retrying or retreating from certain bosses during their final state would result in the background music staying sped up.
- Changed some of the Cave Waterway to feel more fair as well as increased the breath timer to 30 seconds instead of 25 seconds.
